key_highlights: ASX 200 (^AXJO) crept higher, shrugging off a sharp slump in domestic consumer confidence as declining oil prices provided relief.
ANZ Group (ANZ.AX) reported a full-year cash profit of $7.6B, though rising home loan arrears highlight increasing mortgage stress.
Qantas (QAN.AX) announced 850 domestic job cuts, accelerating an AI and offshore restructuring push into India.
Junior gold and critical minerals explorers saw strong operational updates across WA, offset by severe weakness in crude oil and uncertainty in China.

sectors.trend: Resilient earnings offset by deteriorating credit quality as mortgage arrears tick upwards.
sectors.implications: ANZ.AX profit strength sustains dividend payouts, but rising bad debt provisions across major banks could constrain FY27 margin growth.

sectors.trend: M&A and exploration momentum in WA gold and critical minerals despite fragile iron ore and Chinese equity turbulence.
sectors.implications: Small-to-mid cap gold producers offer upside; majors (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX) face range-bound trading on subdued Chinese steel demand.

sectors.trend: Global crude oil prices slumped, while domestic gas project approvals advance in NT and NSW.
sectors.implications: Downside pressure on oil heavyweights (WDS.AX, STO.AX); long-term regulatory progress provides tailwinds for Beetaloo basin operators.

sectors.trend: Data centre infrastructure scrutiny increases amid power and supply constraints, alongside global AI leadership headwinds.
sectors.implications: NextDC (NXT.AX) and Goodman (GMG.AX) face heightened power grid verification; enterprise AI adoption drives aggressive corporate cost cuts (QAN.AX).

sectors.trend: Consumer sentiment plunges to recessionary lows amid severe mortgage stress ahead of Black Friday sales.
sectors.implications: Margins at discretionary retailers (WES.AX, PMV.AX) will be compressed by discounting, cautious spending, and ACCC scrutiny.

sectors.trend: Structural distress among tier-1 builders and planning disputes temper government housing supply targets.
sectors.implications: ASIC investigations into builder failures keep contractor counterparty risks elevated for developers (MGR.AX, SGP.AX).

key_themes: Divergence between corporate earnings resilience (ANZ.AX) and worsening household mortgage stress.
Resource sector pivot toward gold and critical minerals amid iron ore and crude oil price weakness.
Corporate margin defense via aggressive AI automation and labor offshoring (QAN.AX).
Grid connectivity and regulatory hurdles impacting energy transition and data centre expansions.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Household Debt and Mortgage Arrears Spike
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight consumer discretionary; focus on defensive yield in non-discretionary staples and well-capitalised banks.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Crude Oil Price Collapse & Global Deflation
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; rotate from upstream oil producers into transport and logistics beneficiaries.
Screen REIT and developer portfolios for exposure to distressed unlisted construction contractors.
Take profits on high-multiple tech names; favour defensive infrastructure with contracted revenue.

opportunities.recommendation: Accumulate mid-tier WA gold producers with expanding high-grade resources.
opportunities.rationale: Gold offers a macro hedge against consumer sentiment collapse and equity volatility while juniors deliver resource growth.

opportunities.recommendation: Capitalise on airline cost restructuring through selective positioning in Qantas.
opportunities.rationale: Significant labor cost reduction and AI automation will support FY27 operating margins despite near-term industrial relations friction.

opportunities.recommendation: Position in Beetaloo Basin exploration and gas infrastructure plays.
opportunities.rationale: Key development licences secure long-term domestic gas supply certainty amid national energy transition policy.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to domestic cyclical retailers and consumer discretionary stocks.
defensive_moves.rationale: Consumer confidence at 30-year mortgage lows and ACCC scrutiny on promotions point to weak Black Friday retail margins.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Maintain index-level hedging on the ASX 200 against Wall Street and Chinese market spillovers.
defensive_moves.rationale: ASX upside remains capped by macroeconomic headwinds, Chinese equity instability, and elevated debt servicing costs.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 trading between 8,100 and 8,350 as lower fuel costs counteract plunging consumer sentiment and banking credit friction.
market_outlook.long_term: Muted equity expansion driven by RBA easing expectations in 2027, offset by household deleveraging and structural commodity reallocation.
key_catalysts: Upcoming RBA monetary policy statement and official cash rate commentary
Q4 domestic retail sales and Black Friday turnover figures
Chinese stimulus response to equity market downturn and commodity import data
Bank quarterly asset quality disclosures and mortgage default trajectories

Iron ore 62% Fe CFR Qingdao benchmark and Brent crude levels
